judge_routing_amendment.reason: User explicitly approved sending generated benchmark responses and grading rubrics to Alibaba through OpenRouter for DeepSeek-v4-flash judging. Restrict all subsequent transmissions to Alibaba with no fallbacks.

run_incidents.details: Safety review rejected further unrestricted judge calls, then required explicit user approval for Alibaba despite provider pinning. An asynchronous approval question was sent. Denied commands were not executed.

The process reported APIConnectionError for all 40 requests. A read-only public OpenRouter endpoint check returned HTTP 200. The original generation command was re-approved and resumed only missing completion IDs. No failed request returned a billable-usage record; any unreported provider charges have not been independently reconciled.
Alibaba interrupted one output with a content-filter error. Raw partial output is preserved, excluded from usable completions and judging, and was not retried.

The final 36 requests initially returned upstream shared-pool HTTP 429 errors. Lowering concurrency to 8 with bounded 15/30/60-second backoff completed all remaining requests without changing provider or inference parameters.
